Decisions from the user on 2026-09-30.

16. ADW caches each Luna language verdict under the hash of its paragraph. A paragraph costs at most one Luna call, however often the agent edits the file.
17. On Codex, where PostToolUse runs synchronously, a weak paragraph first takes the document language. Luna classifies it in the background at the next prompt, the same way the embedding worker warms today.
18. The stop-word length threshold stays open until the measurement on the German corpora is in. The starting candidate is 8 words without code and paths.
